title: The Fruit of the Spirit Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Fruit of the Spirit Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Fruit of the Spirit Bible crossword: love, joy, peace, longsuffering and the rest of Galatians 5:22 in KJV wording. Free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Nine words in a single verse, and the King James Version gives several of them a shape you will not find in a modern translation — longsuffering where others say patience, temperance where others say self-control, meekness where others say gentleness. The Fruit of the Spirit makes a grid of all nine, in order, exactly as Galatians 5 lists them.

It is one of the more satisfying puzzles to finish, because the long answers cross the short ones and the whole verse assembles itself in front of you. The closing verse is the one the puzzle is made of.
